append_note.description: Add content to the end of an existing note in your Obsidian vault.
append_note.name: append_note

parameters.description: The note's file path in your vault, for example 'Projects/My Note.md'. This is the 'id' returned when you create or list notes.
parameters.name: note_id

parameters.description: The Markdown content to add to the end of the note.
parameters.name: content

appended.description: True when the content was added successfully.

id.description: The note's file path in your vault.

create_note.description: Create a new note in your Obsidian vault.
create_note.name: create_note

parameters.description: The title for the new note. This also becomes the note's file name.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: The content of the note, written in Markdown. Leave blank to create an empty note.
parameters.name: content

parameters.description: The folder in your vault to save the note in, for example 'Projects'. Leave blank to save it at the top level of the vault.
parameters.name: folder

folder.description: The folder the note was saved in, or empty if it was saved at the top level.

id.description: The note's file path in your vault. Use this to update, append to, or delete the note later.

title.description: The title of the note that was created.

delete_note.description: Delete a note from your Obsidian vault.
delete_note.name: delete_note

parameters.description: The note's file path in your vault, for example 'Projects/My Note.md'. This is the 'id' returned when you create or list notes.
parameters.name: note_id

deleted.description: True when the note was deleted.

id.description: The file path of the note that was deleted.

list_notes.description: List the notes in your Obsidian vault.
list_notes.name: list_notes

parameters.description: Only list notes inside this folder, for example 'Projects'. Leave blank to list notes at the top level of your vault.
parameters.name: folder

parameters.description: The maximum number of notes to return.
parameters.name: limit

items.description: The file paths of the notes found, relative to the folder that was listed.

update_note.description: Replace the entire contents of an existing note in your Obsidian vault.
update_note.name: update_note

parameters.description: The note's file path in your vault, for example 'Projects/My Note.md'. This is the 'id' returned when you create or list notes.
parameters.name: note_id

parameters.description: The new content for the note, written in Markdown. This replaces everything currently in the note.
parameters.name: content

id.description: The note's file path in your vault.

description: Create, update, append to, list, and delete notes in your Obsidian vault.
